beforeRemediation.note: Pre-existing prod advisories were 3 moderate + 1 low; the historic narrative that 'four High prod advisories' exist was a stale snapshot from before lockfile refresh that already moved js-yaml to 4.3.0 and fast-uri to 3.1.4. Correct baseline is captured here from `pnpm audit --prod --json`.

afterRemediation.note: `brace-expansion` global override (5.0.8) was added as a clean transitive remediation covering both exceljs>archiver>archiver-utils>glob>minimatch>brace-expansion and exceljs>archiver>readdir-glob>minimatch>brace-expansion paths. pnpm accepted it without manifest/lockfile conflict.

devSideAdvisories.reachabilityEvidence: esbuild is a build-time bundler invoked by tsup during form-contracts build. esbuild dev server (the attack surface for the path-traversal advisory GHSA-g7r4-m6w7-qqqr) is only started via `tsup --watch` for local development and is not started in customer-local or production runtime.
devSideAdvisories.mitigation: Build pipeline is offline; no request handling. Documented and accepted. Will be revisited when tsup upgrades to a transitive esbuild >=0.28.1.

devSideAdvisories.reachabilityEvidence: tar is invoked through node-gyp which is invoked through libxmljs2 native build, which is invoked through @cyclonedx/cyclonedx-npm SBOM generator. This is a one-shot SBOM build script (`pnpm security:dependencies` / CI SBOM), not a request-path module. tar.t/tar.x with member selection is never called from API runtime.
devSideAdvisories.mitigation: Documented and accepted. Will be revisited when @cyclonedx/cyclonedx-npm updates its node-gyp pin.
